description:
get_changes_since has inconsistent return types across store modules:
- ChatStore, ContactStore, MessageStore: Result<ChangesResult, KithError>  where ChangesResult is a named struct with fields added, updated, destroyed, new_state
- SpaceStore: Result<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>, String), KithError>  — a bare tuple with no field names

This means callers of SpaceStore::get_changes_since must know positional tuple semantics (index 0=created, 1=updated(?), 2=new_state) rather than named fields, while the other stores provide a self-documenting struct. The asymmetry will cause confusion when the space handler diverges from the chat/contact/message pattern.

Files:
  crates/kith-store/src/space.rs line 419
  crates/kith-store/src/message.rs line 24 (ChangesResult definition)

Fix: make SpaceStore::get_changes_since return ChangesResult (or a parallel SpaceChangesResult if space needs different fields).
title: get_changes_since returns named struct in chat/contact/message but bare tuple in SpaceStore
